question: Free electrons in a metal are free to move throughout the volume of the metal but do not naturally escape from its surface at room temperature. What is the physical reason responsible for restricting these electrons within the metal surface?

options.A: The gravitational force acting on the electrons is too strong to overcome
options.B: The air pressure outside the metal pushes the electrons back into the surface
options.C: The positive ions at the surface exert an attractive force that creates a potential barrier
options.D: The electrons lose all their kinetic energy due to internal collisions before reaching the surface
